# unsloth-mcp — full LLM corpus

## What it is

`unsloth-mcp` is a FastMCP server + webapp that controls local LLM
fine-tuning on the host's NVIDIA GPU using Unsloth. Agents and users can
queue LoRA/QLoRA training jobs, monitor them through completion, export
quantized GGUF artifacts, and register finished models into Ollama so every
fleet webapp can serve them. Training executes as background subprocesses in
the Unsloth environment (default: the Unsloth Studio venv) — the MCP server
process never imports torch/unsloth.

## Environment

- OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (or Linux/WSL)
- GPU: NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50 (24 GB recommended; QLoRA up to ~27B, 16-bit LoRA
  up to ~9B on 24 GB)
- Unsloth installed (https://unsloth.ai — Studio installer or pip)
- Ollama optional (serving + GGUF registration)
- Python 3.11-3.13, uv, Bun (webapp)

## Configuration

| Env var | Default | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| UNSLOTH_PYTHON | C:\Users\sandr\.unsloth\studio\unsloth_studio\Scripts\python.exe | Unsloth interpreter for jobs |
| UNSLOTH_MCP_DATA | ./data | jobs/models/datasets/db root |
| UNSLOTH_VRAM_GUARD | 0.85 | refuse jobs when used VRAM fraction exceeds this |
| OLLAMA_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434 | Ollama endpoint |
| MCP_PORT / WEB_PORT | 11150 | HTTP transport port |
| MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | bind host |

## Tool surface

`unsloth_ops(operation=...)` portmanteau:

- `system` — GPU, VRAM, Unsloth venv, CUDA, Ollama, active jobs
- `train` — start QLoRA/LoRA job (model_name, dataset [hf://org/name or
  .jsonl path], max_seq_length, load_in_4bit, r, lora_alpha, batch,
  gradient_accumulation_steps, max_steps|num_train_epochs, learning_rate,
  output_dir)
- `jobs_list(limit, offset)` — paginated jobs
- `jobs_status(job_id)` — detail + log tail
- `jobs_cancel(job_id)` — cancel queued/running (kills process tree)
- `jobs_export(job_id, quantization_method)` — GGUF export job
- `jobs_register_ollama(job_id, model_name_to_register)` — POST /api/create
- `models_list` — data/models/ artifacts
- `datasets_list` — data/datasets/ files

Prefab: `show_training_app`, `show_system_app` (app=True, plain-text fallback).

Returns: `{success, message, data}`; errors carry `error` + `error_type`
(validation, not_configured, busy, vram_guard, not_found,
missing_artifact, ollama_error).

## REST API (FastAPI, 11150)

GET /api/health, /api/v1/diagnostics, /api/dashboard, /api/tools,
/api/skills, /api/skills/{name}, /skill/{name}, /api/jobs, /api/jobs/{id},
/api/jobs/{id}/log, /api/models, /api/datasets, /api/gpu, /api/logs,
/api/onboarding/status, /api/llm/discover; POST /api/jobs, /api/llm/chat;
DELETE /api/jobs/{id}. MCP transport: /mcp (streamable HTTP, FastMCP 3.4.4).

## Job lifecycle

queued → running → done | failed | cancelled. Single worker, VRAM guard,
subprocess isolation. Server restart marks orphaned jobs failed
("server restarted"). Logs at data/jobs/{id}.log.

## Webapp (Vite, 11151)

Pages: Dashboard (hero + KPI cards + onboarding CTA), Jobs (create form +
job list + detail modal + log tail), Models, Datasets, Inbox (completed
jobs), Tools (dynamic discovery), Skills (SKILL.md render), Chat
(skill-first, personalities, localStorage history, Ollama proxy), Settings
(health + LLM providers), Help page, Logs (ring buffer).

## Troubleshooting quick hits

- queued forever → VRAM guard or another job running
- exit 1 immediately → UNSLOTH_PYTHON missing deps; probe with
  `& <python> -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"`
- OOM → batch 1-3, QLoRA, shorter max_seq_length
- Ollama register 4xx → ollama running? tag shape `name:quant`?
- port busy → start.ps1 clears 11150/11151 automatically
